QuestInfo.name: Reminiscing
QuestInfo.0: Chief Stan and Mrs. Ming Ming is near a divorce. Go find out if they are mending things over from their son Jay.
QuestInfo.1: Jay tells you about #b#MDmirrorD_323_2_##k where Chief Stan and Mrs. Ming Ming enjoyed dates before they were married. He believes that they will mend things over if they were reminded fo their fond memories in this place. Go get something from #MDmirrorD_323_2_# to stir up their old emotions.
QuestInfo.2: Mrs. Ming Ming decides to forgive Chief Stan after reminiscing over the stuff you brought from #MDmirrorD_323_2_#. There is no winner in fights between couples.

0.0: Mrs. Ming Ming isn't about to forgive Stan that easily. She wouldn't be mentioning divorce if it wasn't the end of a long string of disappointments. We need a special arrangement to bring them back together.
0.1: Ah, how about this? Let's remind them about their memories. If my mother recalls the fresh feelings that she had when she was dating, we could definitely melt her heart! I just need you to get the items that could remind them.

yes.0: I heard my mother and father grew close in #b#MDmirrorD_323_2_##k, eating coconuts and picking beautiful shells together. So, if you get #r8#k #r#t4000968##k and #r#t4000969##k each and take them to my mother, we might able to turn around her feelings.

no.0: Did I bother you with all my family business? I'll take care of it. I'm so sorry to be a bother.

1.0: I don't have anything else to say. I'm already so disappointed in him. \r\n#L0##bDo you remember these?#l\n#k
1.1: These... Remind me of when I was dating my husband. I first met him when he got knocked up by the Coconut... I was the one to treat his wounds. I found him to be so charming back then... I guess I really was blinded by love.

yes.0: Well, a gift is a gift... I'm sure he learned his lesson. I'll make his favorite dish tonight, spicy mushroom saute!
yes.1: Are you confused? They were acting like they were going to split anytime, but now they're totally fine. That's just how married people fight.

default.0: I can't let him off the hook again. I'm going to part with him.

npc.0: Deliver #r8#k #r#t4000968##k and #r#t4000969##k each to my mother. It might ease her feelings.
